title: Retain raw pilot primary errors through cleanup and accounting failures
body:
## Problem and resulting behavior

A capture failure could be replaced by a later cleanup error. In the rejected v2 controller, a raw-stream cap failure followed by `fsync` failure could lose the cap cause, skip later descriptor closes, and prevent terminal accounting. A `SPAWN_RETURNED` ledger error could also leave acquired pipe handles outside the explicit cleanup set; final ledger close could override an earlier failure or apparent success.

The preserved v3 successor registers acquired pipes immediately, attempts each cleanup/sync/close independently, keeps the first failure primary and observed later failures secondary, quarantines failed ledger appends, and emits success only after accounting closes. This new isolated package publishes that source, its independent reviews, the rejected version and exact failure evidence, and reproducible fake-only tests. It establishes scoped source behavior and finite conformance; original compiler-input closure and full bootstrap-control campaign remain open.

## Contribution and source identity

Original source investigation: [PR #6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321). Frozen H25 benchmark: [PR #6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029). Immediate predecessor: [PR #6397](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6397).

New package only: `research/h25-raw-pilot-failure-accounting`, **68 files / 1,493,862 bytes**, all Git mode `100644`. There are 59 exact mapped retained files / 1,417,389 bytes. Manifest SHA256 `e888f1a8436ed86a5c9b5d09d2c685cfafab59a83b95ba7e3fc1aecf7fa2397d`; source-map SHA256 `08daccd3bc4439ce93c0af63abb6a98ca058b2e41211877717dcd9f42bad557c`.

Remote reviewed head `edc2820ba023b804ef1351a88e2fe31bf8d489dd`, tree `049436557a10ac13d7cc49147b8ececdce2c637d`, sole parent/base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. The local qualification commit is `761d5a58f58b7215d4c561c44288f081e1da2ff5`, with the identical tree and parent. Git Data publication uses the connected account's author/committer; both commit identities and exact bytes are retained separately.

This is the directly assigned prerequisite control-family contribution authorized while original activity credit remains unchanged. No task picker, selected-frontier change, new kappa or performance claim is proposed. The controller prototype has frozen local context/authority requirements and is not a portable admitted native collector. The registered hook invokes only the static checker and fake-only harness; it never invokes controller main.

## Validation completed locally

- Independent source review rejected v2 before execution. One bounded v3 repair and seven added combined-fault cases were independently reviewed. The resulting **24 unique methods** passed once normally and once with `-O`; every process/proc/selector/group boundary is fake, with owned temporary data only.
- Exact publication/source review verified every package and origin byte, staged blob and mode. The static checker imports no controller or original module and launches no subprocess. Its **seven archive-fault controls** reject changed/missing/extra bytes and invalid scope/accounting metadata.
- One official registered replay passed metadata, the seven archive controls and the unchanged 24-method normal/optimized pair: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=partial`.
- `check_research_commit.py --ref 761d5a58f58b7215d4c561c44288f081e1da2ff5 --check-source-history --check-modes` passed all 68 committed files. History coverage is declared-base ancestor availability, not complete scientific history. The unrelated missing base-PDF object in the local alternate cache remains unrepaired and explicitly unclaimed.
- The official selected-package export and `--check-inputs` passed. One package-only, read-only Git-free cold replay of the same three commands passed with empty executable PATH and fresh bytecode namespaces. All 68 exported bytes were compared again afterward; files remain `0444`, directories `0555`. Export SHA256 `002708dda50dd26462d93bca3a69fe9e9468948e77221c87ff153411e4ca4540`.
- Independent final execution/export cross-review passed at exact local commit/tree, checking 21 publication raw/time files, complete method names/exits and transport equality without another replay. Its retained receipt SHA256 is `b919df06b2ff3a059aeddfa4bc3725a08b9697ebba0ce4e1ba45c8049a7e900a`.

Reproduction from repository root, CPython 3.12 standard library only:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-raw-pilot-failure-accounting
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/h25-raw-pilot-failure-accounting --check-source-history --check-modes
```

No timing threshold is used. The checker is reviewed for this exact small packet under watchdogs; its post-read size checks are not a general hostile-archive allocation guarantee.

## Qualification and accounting limits

Real process cleanup, descendants, deadlines and a positive main queue remain untested. On partial raw-write failure, completed-block byte/hash counters may omit a retained file prefix; actual raw-file readback or an explicit unknown disposition is required. Delivered-byte capture is distinct from complete intended GCC emission, reporter fidelity, original-consumer equivalence, loader closure, C07 lifetime and complete compiler-input closure.

The native eight-job pilot closed with source and synthetic evidence only, with **zero compiler queries, zero shell-stub calibrations and zero original baseline/bootstrap-control campaign cases**. Its proposed native reservation was never granted or spent. The original execution admissions remain withheld. No original Root/provider/helper/native-TCB/entry, policy or namespace operation ran.

The app goal service is separately observed paused; documentation changes do not alter service status.

The preserved canonical policy record is 94.550533479 seconds. New source controls add 0.74 and local publication qualification adds 3.66, producing a supplemental **98.950533479 / 2400** policy seconds within the original initial 600. No new budget. GNU-time individual maxrss and policy debit are not a full physical invoice. Preparation, reviews, Pro, publication, final metadata and historical gaps remain **OPEN_NOT_ZERO**. The float-spelling metadata-readback failure is preserved; no tests were rerun to repair bookkeeping.

## Related work and bounded coverage

Repository: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds . The exact [37-node known dependency graph](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/edc2820ba023b804ef1351a88e2fe31bf8d489dd/research/h25-raw-pilot-failure-accounting/lineage/PR-COVERAGE-NEXT-v4.json) retains its scope and historical metadata limits. [PR6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321) is the canonical technical handoff; [PR6397](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6397) supplies the exact two-command compiler-input closure domain/criterion correction. [PR6377](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6377) and [PR6379](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6379) retain their distinct source-only/conditional results; [PR6371](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6371), [PR6373](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6373) and [PR6374](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6374) retain separate entry/caller/stage constructors and unadmitted runtime obligations.

At 22:02:13 UTC, main was unchanged, the owned fork permissions were verified, and the first 30 open PRs by update were inspected. The plausible keyword matches PR6395 and PR6415 were checked by body and paths: they concern PR4440 integer Taylor evaluation and PR4345 matrix-header conjugation respectively, with separate sources/contracts/quantities. This is bounded overlap coverage; no global novelty, unpublished-work or all-current-source audit is claimed.

## Open next questions

For the collector, first admit the actual command/context/funding and known-group/unknown-spawn termination disposition; retain partial writes and failed accounting honestly. This PR grants no native execution.

For compiler-input closure, close the property-specific installed driver prefix/spec build frame and complete all named complements/currentness/fit. The archive records the Pro consultation frontier; subsequent Pro consultation work identifies `/usr/libexec/gcc/` as a native-recipe candidate with a concrete `gcc-cross/` competitor. Retained generator/parameter files are being analyzed for phase preservation; source-package parameters are not an actual build phase record. A complete final `gcc.o` export is one sufficient method, not a newly mandatory engineering criterion. Neither the candidate nor these tests qualifies the installed field or original compiler-input closure.

After genuine source/configuration/parent/native/receiver/funding/C06/C07 admission, run the intact V01 and every original bootstrap-control campaign case in both Python modes under unchanged bounds. No helper, prefix refusal or publication may replace those obligations.

## Credit and merge scope

Chris R/Clear1nsight retain contribution credit, alongside predecessor PR6029/PR5864/PR6321 work, Douglas R. Colkitt and upstream maintainers, and unpaidmoon/Cursor-Grok where retained source lineage records them. Substantial OpenAI Pro, Codex and GPT-6.1 Sol Max assistance is disclosed. Independent AI source/export reviews are scoped evidence, not independent human acceptance or a formal proof kernel. Exact retained notices/licenses and failed evidence are preserved. The unnecessary raw browser/sidebar snapshot was excluded from the public copy; its original remains local.

The change is confined to one reversible, isolated opt-in research package. Shared production/source files and upstream tooling are unchanged. Hosted exact-head planning/replay is pending at submission and will be read back separately; local success is not hosted success.
